name: Balanced 4-1-4-1

slots.why: Starts short passing moves; a compact block does not need a sweeper.
Support full-back helps the wide midfielder without overlapping unless it is safe.
Central defender in a settled back four. Cover is the alternate.
Ball-playing defender starts moves with passes to the holding midfielder and the wide players.
Support full-back on the right, doing the same job as on the left.
Holding midfielder protects the centre-backs and takes the ball off them; he stays in front of the defence.
Wide midfielder provides width and tracks back to help the full-back.
Defensive central midfielder pairs with the holding midfielder to keep the block tight.
Box-to-box midfielder is the runner who joins the striker's attacks.
Wide midfielder on the right, doing the same job as on the left.
Lone striker attacks the space. Poacher stays in the box; Advanced Forward runs the channels.

description: A compact 4-1-4-1 with a dedicated screen behind a four-man midfield.
whyGood: It gives strong defensive spacing and central control while retaining wide outlets.
whyThisShape: A compact 4-1-4-1: a holding midfielder screens the defence behind a flat line of four midfielders, with one striker. It is hard to play through the middle and balances defence with support for the striker.
whenToUse: As a safe default when you want control without committing many players forward, or away from home against a stronger side.
whenNotToUse: When you need to chase a goal: there is a single striker and no creative attacking midfielder to feed him.

instructionRationale.Standard Line of Engagement: Defend from a middle block; the forward roles still determine which players challenge the ball.
instructionRationale.Standard Defensive Line: Keep the back line at its mentality-relative default rather than explicitly pushing it up or dropping it.
instructionRationale.Shorter Passing: Use the short connections supplied by the selected midfield and supporting forwards.
instructionRationale.Regroup: Recover the defensive shape after losing possession; this is a positioning choice, not a measured guarantee about stamina or defensive success.
instructionRationale.Distribute To Full Backs: The selected outlets match where this tactic starts its build-up or releases pressure.
instructionRationale.Never Time Wasting: The kick-off baseline; review deliberately when score and time justify a different policy.
instructionRationale.Roll It Out: Start possession through the chosen short outlets instead of routinely contesting a long kick.

keyRequirements: Disciplined holding midfielder who can also circulate the ball
Hard-working wide midfielders who recover into shape
One central midfielder able to cover ground and support the lone striker
A self-sufficient striker with good movement
setupNotes: All three phases have been reviewed. Standard sliders are relative to the chosen mentality; unselected toggles intentionally leave FM to choose the response.
Player instructions use the selected role and duty defaults unless additional instructions are listed. Crossing and overlap settings are starting choices to review against the selected players.
